meta_description:
18K likes, 182 comments - bazaarindia on October 10, 2026: "For Shanaya Kapoor (@shanayakapoor02), it’s the nerves, the hunger, and the need to never stop dreaming that keep her going. Inspired by watching Shah Rukh Khan and her uncle Anil Kapoor bring the same attention to their craft years into their careers, she hopes to hold on to that same sense of wonder. 

Read the full cover story at the link in bio.

Editor: Rasna Bhasin (@rasnabhasin)
Interview: Jhanvi Duggal (@jhanvii.23)
Photographer: Tuhin Chandra (@tuhin_chandra)
Stylist: Dolla Baruah (@dollaypop)
Make-up Artist: Riddhima Sharma (@makeupbyriddhima)
Hair Artist: Hiral Bhatia (@hiralbhatia)
Editorial Coordinator: Shalini Kanojia (@shalinikanojia)
Assistant Stylists: Tanya Doshi (@tanyaa14) and Shrushti Nisar (@shrushti.nisar.9)
Assistant Coordinator: Shruti Gupta (@howdoyousayshruti)
Artist PR Agency: Think Talkies (@think_talkies)

Shanaya is wearing a Perfume Dress from H&M x Elie Saab (@hm) (@eliesaabworld)

#HarpersBazaarIndia #DigitalCover #ShanayaKapoor".
